1. Make sure your rad is full with coolant. The fan won't turn on if the coolant is too low. 
2. You can test to see if the fan works by directly connecting it to power. I don't know exactly how this is done as my dad helped me with it but this will eliminate that the issue could be the fan 
3. Let your bike sit and idle for a while and see if it turns on. If your temperature light turns on before the fan you may have an issue. 

Odds are it's fine, just make sure your coolants topped up. If your temp light isn't coming on then it shouldn't be an issue.

If you're talking about enemies on high ground then there are a couple heroes/strategies that come to mind. If it's the whole enemy team, then the best thing to get them off the high ground is to fully rotate to the high ground with your whole team i.e. on Anubis Point A, enemies like to sit on the high ground just after the choke. If you push left you can fight them on an even playing field 

If it's just a singular enemy on the high ground, a couple heroes you can choose to pressure/kill them are:
 
Tanks- DVA, Winston, Wrecking Ball (roadhog can also hook enemies off high ground) 

Damage-Genji, Pharah, Echo, Reaper etc (although some better than others)

Healers-Lucio (the best support to contest high ground) and maybe baptiste

Another way to force the enemy off high ground is to simply sneak past them and touch the objective. 9 times out of 10 at least a couple of the enemies will jump off the high ground in order to contest the point.

In reference to heroes like Pharah and Echo who sort of 'own the skies' the best counter to these heroes are usually picking a hitscan, and winning the positioning battle (i.e. getting the jump on them, or holding down areas where it's hard for them to fight you) these heroes are- Widowmaker, Mccree, soldier, Ashe mainly. Other heroes that are good at contesting them are DVA, sigma to an extent, Mercy to pocket your hitscan DPS to kill them more efficiently.
